name: Start mining
description: Pick the drill (1), place it on copper ore and run conveyors (2) from it into your core. Belts face the way you rotate them (R).

name: Smelt iron
description: Belt iron ore into a Smelter: Iron Plate (4) and its plates on to the core.

name: Find coal
description: Steel needs coal, and your home tile has none. Open the world map (Tab), select a neighbouring tile with coal and claim it (C).

name: Link your tiles
description: On the new tile, mine coal and belt it into an export port (6) placed in the I/O zone bordering your home tile. On your home tile, put an import port (7) in the zone bordering the coal tile: ports pair by zone, whichever way they face.

name: Make steel
description: A Steel Mill (5) costs copper plates too: smelt some with a Smelter: Copper Plate (3). Feed the mill iron plates and coal. Unit cores and thrusters need steel.

name: Lift off
description: Lay unit frame (0), put a unit core (8) and thrusters (9) on it, then hover the core with no building picked and press G.
